title: Supply Chain Weather Forecast
subtitle: One week, four clocks — separate stations, no composite score.

stations.label: Restart clock
facts: Typhoon Dolphin made landfall near Yuhuan, Zhejiang.
Reuters reported about 1,500 Shanghai flights cancelled, 55 Fujian ferry routes suspended and more than 500 Yangshan vessels moved to shelter.
Current evidence supports a Monday recovery clock, not a sustained congestion claim.
stations.decision: Check exposed ports, airports, rail nodes, vessels and customer promises before confirming Monday commitments.
stations.watch: Yangshan, Ningbo, Shanghai airports, Yangtze River Delta rail and Zhejiang/Fujian port recovery.

stations.label: Entry-file station
facts: CBP guidance covers USTR forced-labor Section 301 duties of 10% to 12.5% on imports from sixty economies.
The guidance applies to goods entered for consumption or withdrawn from warehouse on or after July 24, with HTSUS sequence instructions.
Federal Register timing and in-transit treatment make dated proof and broker instructions operational work.
stations.decision: Assign origin evidence, Chapter 99 sequence, exemption proof, broker instruction and finance review for exposed entries.
stations.watch: CBP CSMS updates, filing errors, exemption details and counsel-reviewed product decisions.

stations.label: Freight/import station
facts: Reuters/NRF/Hackett forecast August major-port imports at 2.2 million TEUs, down 4.2% year over year.
FreightWaves/Freightos reported Asia-North America spot rates down 60% to 70%, with West Coast at $1,744/FEU and East Coast at $2,733/FEU.
Drewry's August 6 World Container Index moved up 1% to $4,297 per 40-foot container after three weekly declines.
stations.decision: Keep forecasts, lane rates and index cards separate; change bookings only where the card maps to live demand or a customer promise.
stations.watch: Next Drewry and Freightos/FreightWaves cards, July port actuals and the next NRF/Hackett Global Port Tracker update.

stations.label: Scarce-input station
facts: ISM July Manufacturing PMI was 55.6, with Supplier Deliveries 58.9, Prices 71.1 and Customers' Inventories 40.7.
ISM listed electrical components, integrated circuits, memory, rare earth components, semiconductors, steel and tungsten products in short supply.
Reuters reported polysilicon tariff/minimum-price measures with December 4 implementation delay.
stations.decision: Rank reservations by service-critical or profitable demand; assign approval for reserve, qualify, hedge, prepay or stand down.
stations.watch: Next ISM readings, supplier payment terms, polysilicon implementation detail and generic-drug policy text.

stations.label: Food-input station
facts: FAO July Food Price Index was 131.1, up 0.6% from June.
FAO reported cereals up 3.4%, wheat up 5.8%, vegetable oils up 2.0%, sugar up 5.6%, meat down 2.8% and dairy down 0.7%.
Reuters reported Odesa seaport damage; the port complex is a key agricultural export artery, but cargo-flow impact was not yet quantified.
stations.decision: Keep food category moves and Black Sea logistics as trigger cards for buy timing, substitute qualification and customer communication.
stations.watch: FAO category updates, Odesa cargo-flow evidence and supplier quote validity windows.

newsletterInsert.headline: Supply Chain Weather: one week, four clocks
newsletterInsert.copy: This week's weather is not a composite risk score. It is five separate stations: restart recovery, entry-file compliance, freight/import lanes, scarce inputs and food-input triggers. Each station has a different owner, trigger and falsifier.

sources: ISM July Manufacturing PMI and Services PMI
FreightWaves / Freightos Asia-North America spot-rate reporting
CBP CSMS #69326983 and Federal Register Section 301 notice
Reuters Typhoon Dolphin, Odesa, Port Hedland, polysilicon and generic-drug policy reporting
